title: Finding GPT-4’s mistakes with GPT-4
summary: CriticGPT, a model based on GPT-4, writes critiques of ChatGPT responses to help human trainers spot mistakes during RLHF
body: CriticGPT, a model based on GPT-4, writes critiques of ChatGPT responses to help human trainers spot mistakes during RLHF
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了基于GPT-4构建的模型CriticGPT，旨在为人类训练师提供针对ChatGPT回复的自动化错误和幻觉批评，从而有效提升RLHF阶段人类标注的质量和效率。原始信息显示：CriticGPT, a model based on GPT-4, writes critiques of ChatGPT responses to help human trainers spot mistakes during RLHF。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Finding GPT-4’s mistakes with GPT-4”。其重要性主要体现在：介绍了OpenAI利用GPT-4发现模型自身错误的新方法，对改进RLHF对齐流程有重要实际价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
